title: Fun East Nashville Studio
description:
Explore Nashville using this cute studio to call home base. Walkable to East Nashville bars, restaurants, shops, and more, the studio is just a ten-minute drive to downtown Nashville. Please note this space is a part of a larger home, however it has its own entrance, parking spot, yard, and is cut off from the rest of the house.

Local spots:
Shotgun Willies BBQ
El Fuego
Inglewood Lounge
The Underdog
American Legion Post 82
High Class Hillbilly
Backslide Vintage

The space
This is a studio which includes a bedroom/living room space, a full bathroom, and a kitchenette. Please note this space is part of a larger house. I will not have access to your space, and you won't have access to mine. You have your own entrance and fenced in yard. There's a locked door seperating the AirBnB from the main house.

While there is no oven, there is a brand new double hot plate.

Guest access
You have your own parking spot at the front of the house. You'll take a walkway down the side of the house to entrance of the studio.

Other things to note
Please let me know if you will need the air mattress.
